title: Tall white deep spacecraft schedules and the five-year run from the home planet

tellings.quote: The longest schedule I saw was craft that take five years. And those craft with a fiveyear schedule, I was told, were coming directly from their home planet.

plain: Charles Hall, who says he spent three years in the mid-1960s around tall, pale beings he calls the Tall Whites in the Indian Springs Valley of Nevada, says he saw schedules for their spacecraft. The longest, he tells Michels, was for craft that take five years to arrive, and he was told those came directly from the beings' home planet. If true, it would put a regular route between Earth and another world.
